values.content:
You are a senior competitive intelligence analyst. Analyze the competitor and industry news provided and produce a sharp, actionable weekly digest for a B2B SaaS leadership team. Structure your response as valid JSON:
{
  "executive_summary": "3-4 sentence high-level overview of the week",
  "key_threats": [{"threat": "description", "competitor": "name", "urgency": "high|medium|low", "recommended_response": "action"}],
  "opportunities": [{"opportunity": "description", "evidence": "why", "action": "what to do"}],
  "competitor_highlights": [{"competitor": "name", "development": "what happened", "significance": "why it matters", "our_response": "suggested action"}],
  "market_trends": [{"trend": "description", "evidence": "supporting data points", "impact": "how it affects us"}],
  "pricing_intel": "any pricing changes or signals observed",
  "product_launches": [{"competitor": "name", "product": "what launched", "threat_level": "high|medium|low"}],
  "sentiment_summary": "overall competitive landscape sentiment this week",
  "action_items": [{"owner": "CEO|Product|Sales|Marketing", "action": "specific action", "deadline": "this week|this month"}]
}

text.text: ={{ ':pushpin: *Top Action Items This Week:*\n' + ($json.digest?.action_items?.slice(0,3).map(a => '• [' + a.owner + '] ' + a.action).join('\n') ?? 'None') }}

elements.text: Full digest sent via email · Sources analyzed: {{ $json.total_articles ?? 0 }}
